catalogue.label: Snap share
catalogue.definition: His share of his team's offensive snaps. nflverse publishes each game's share (rounded to the percent), not the team's snap total, so several games are the mean of his per-game shares over games with snap counts (each game weighted equally) — the card's Snap share.
catalogue.aggregation: mean of per-game snap share over games with snap counts
catalogue.reason: no snap counts recorded for his games

catalogue.label: Route participation (estimate)
catalogue.definition: Dropbacks he was on the field for (a receiver, back or tight end) / his team's dropbacks with participation, in the games he played. An estimate: being on the field for a dropback is not a route run (runs ~10–15% low).
catalogue.denominator: team dropbacks with participation in his games
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the games he played in the window (never a mean of weekly %)
catalogue.source: nflverse participation: who was on the field each play
catalogue.reason: Routes: nflverse publishes participation after the season (2025 is the last season with it), so this season is blank until then; no licensed routes feed is connected.

catalogue.label: Targets per route run (estimate)
catalogue.definition: Targets / dropbacks he was on the field for, in games with participation.
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the window

catalogue.reason: Routes: nflverse publishes participation after the season (2025 is the last season with it), so this season is blank until then; no licensed routes feed is connected.

catalogue.label: Yards per route run (estimate)
catalogue.definition: Receiving yards / dropbacks he was on the field for, in games with participation.
catalogue.numerator: receiving yards in games with participation
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the window
catalogue.source: nflverse participation: who was on the field each play
catalogue.reason: Routes: nflverse publishes participation after the season (2025 is the last season with it), so this season is blank until then; no licensed routes feed is connected.

catalogue.label: Routes run
catalogue.definition: Routes run from a licensed charting feed. None is connected (FTN and PFF sell one; see docs/DATA_INVENTORY.md).
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window
catalogue.source: a licensed routes feed: not connected
catalogue.reason: No licensed routes feed is connected; nflverse participation is published after the season.

catalogue.label: Target share change
catalogue.definition: His target share in his last 2 games played in the window minus his target share in his games before them (at least 2), each part his targets / his team's targets summed over its games: +5.0 points = he went from, say, 18 % to 23 % of the targets. The measure DFS's role trend reads (a change of 5 points or more counts there).
catalogue.numerator: targets / team targets in his last 2 games, minus the same in his games before them
catalogue.denominator: his games played in the window: the last 2, and 2 or more before them
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over his last 2 games played in the window, minus the same over his games before them in the window; points of share, signed
catalogue.source: nflverse weekly player stats (team totals: his team's game totals); the measure DFS's role trend reads
catalogue.reason: Needs his last 2 games played in the window and at least 2 before them, each with the numbers, and enough team volume (20 team targets or carries, 60 team snaps per 2 games): pick a longer window.
catalogue.graded: Graded on 2025 weeks 5–18 (Half PPR), in their next game: after "role up" players finished 0.2 points above the other players against their projection (−0.2 to +0.6; 1,022 games) — no measurable difference; after "role down" level with the others against their projection (−0.4 to +0.5; 815 games) — no measurable difference.

catalogue.label: Carry share change
catalogue.definition: His carry share in his last 2 games played in the window minus his carry share in his games before them (at least 2), each part his carries / his team's carries summed over its games. Running backs only, as on DFS (a change of 10 points or more counts there).

catalogue.label: Snap share change
catalogue.definition: His snap share in his last 2 games played in the window minus his snap share in his games before them (at least 2), each part his offensive snaps / his team's offensive snaps summed over its games (the team's snaps worked out from his snaps and his published snap share, rounded). Unlike the Snap share column (a mean of per-game shares), this is summed snaps over summed snaps, as DFS's role trend reads it (10 points or more counts there).

catalogue.denominator: his games played in the window: the last 2, and 2 or more before them

catalogue.label: Drops
catalogue.definition: Catchable passes he dropped, as Pro Football Reference's charters mark them.
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window (the games PFR covered)
catalogue.source: Pro Football Reference advanced stats, weekly, via nflverse
catalogue.reason: Pro Football Reference has no row for his games in this window (it lists a player once he has a target, carry or pass), so this is unknown, not zero.

catalogue.label: Drops per target
catalogue.definition: Pro Football Reference's drops / his targets in the games PFR covered (a game PFR has no row for is out of both).
catalogue.denominator: targets in the games PFR covered
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the window
catalogue.source: Pro Football Reference advanced stats, weekly, via nflverse
catalogue.reason: Pro Football Reference has no row for his games in this window (it lists a player once he has a target, carry or pass), so this is unknown, not zero.

catalogue.label: Broken tackles
catalogue.definition: Tackles he broke or made a defender miss, running and after the catch (Pro Football Reference's charting).
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window (the games PFR covered)
catalogue.source: Pro Football Reference advanced stats, weekly, via nflverse
catalogue.reason: Pro Football Reference has no row for his games in this window (it lists a player once he has a target, carry or pass), so this is unknown, not zero.

catalogue.label: Broken tackles per touch
catalogue.definition: Broken tackles / his carries + catches in the games PFR covered.
catalogue.denominator: carries + receptions in the games PFR covered
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the window
catalogue.source: Pro Football Reference advanced stats, weekly, via nflverse
catalogue.reason: Pro Football Reference has no row for his games in this window (it lists a player once he has a target, carry or pass), so this is unknown, not zero.

catalogue.label: Yards before contact per carry
catalogue.definition: Rushing yards gained before the first defender touched him, per carry (Pro Football Reference's yards and carries, the same games): mostly the blocking.

catalogue.label: Yards after contact per carry
catalogue.definition: Rushing yards gained after the first contact, per carry (Pro Football Reference): mostly the runner.

catalogue.label: Receiving yards after contact
catalogue.definition: Receiving yards after the first contact. Pro Football Reference publishes it per season only, not per game, so no window here can use it.
catalogue.source: Pro Football Reference advanced stats, weekly, via nflverse: season file only
catalogue.reason: Pro Football Reference publishes receiving yards after contact per season, not per game, so a window cannot use it.

catalogue.label: Bad throws per attempt
catalogue.definition: Throws Pro Football Reference's charters mark off target or uncatchable / his pass attempts in the games PFR covered. PFR's own rate leaves spikes and throwaways out of the attempts; this one keeps them, so it reads a little lower.
catalogue.denominator: pass attempts in the games PFR covered
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the window
catalogue.source: Pro Football Reference advanced stats, weekly, via nflverse
catalogue.reason: Pro Football Reference has no row for his games in this window (it lists a player once he has a target, carry or pass), so this is unknown, not zero.

catalogue.label: Times pressured
catalogue.definition: Dropbacks on which Pro Football Reference's charters saw him hurried, hit or sacked.
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window (the games PFR covered)
catalogue.source: Pro Football Reference advanced stats, weekly, via nflverse
catalogue.reason: Pro Football Reference has no row for his games in this window (it lists a player once he has a target, carry or pass), so this is unknown, not zero.

catalogue.label: Pressured per dropback
catalogue.definition: Pro Football Reference's pressures (hurried, hit or sacked) / his dropbacks in the games PFR covered (attempts + sacks + scrambles from the play-by-play).
catalogue.denominator: dropbacks in the games PFR covered
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the window
catalogue.source: Pro Football Reference advanced stats, weekly, via nflverse
catalogue.reason: Pro Football Reference has no row for his games in this window (it lists a player once he has a target, carry or pass), so this is unknown, not zero.

catalogue.label: On-target throws per attempt
catalogue.definition: Accurate throws per attempt. Pro Football Reference publishes it in its season file only (not per game, and not for this season yet), so no window here can use it.
catalogue.source: Pro Football Reference advanced stats, weekly, via nflverse: season file only
catalogue.reason: Pro Football Reference publishes on-target throws per season only, so a window cannot use it.

body.howto:
- **One row per player over the window you pick**: the season, his last 3 or 5 *games played*, the last 3 or 5 *calendar weeks* (a bye or a missed game leaves fewer games: **G** says how many), or a week range.
- **Per game** divides the window's total by the games he played in it; shares and rates keep their own denominators (target share = his targets / his team's targets in the games he played).
- A share over several games is the summed numerator over the summed denominator, never an average of weekly percentages.
- A dash means the number cannot be worked out here (no targets, a season without charting, routes in season); hover it for the reason. Never zero.
- **The weeks**: drag the two handles, or tap a week number, to pick any weeks; one handle on the other is a single week. **Compare with other weeks** adds a second stretch: under each number, its change from those weeks (a share in points of share), each stretch from its own sums; a greyed change rests on one game or a small sample on one side. **By week** shows one number across the weeks, then the stretch's own value and its trend: a dash is a bye or a game he did not play, never 0.
